WITH cur AS (SELECT procedure_code, line_paid_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication),
tot AS (SELECT SUM(line_paid_amount) t, SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='G0483') x FROM cur)
SELECT ROUND(x/t,4) AS share_fraction, x AS cpt_paid, t AS total_paid FROM tot

WITH prim AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims
               WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2),
cur AS (SELECT r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.payer_class, r.payment_date FROM sem.remit_claims r
        JOIN prim p USING (claim_key, payer_key) WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.paid_amount > 0),
d AS (SELECT c.payer_class, c.payment_date - p.first_sub AS days FROM cur c JOIN prim p USING (claim_key, payer_key))
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS paid_claims, ROUND(MEDIAN(days),1) AS median_days,
       ROUND(QUANTILE_CONT(days,0.9),1) AS p90_days FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH den AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND is_denied),
codes AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.claim_key, a.payer_key, a.carc_code FROM sem.adjustments a
          JOIN den USING (claim_key, payer_key)
          WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code='CO' AND a.is_denial_carc)
SELECT carc_code, COUNT(*) AS denied_claims FROM codes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

WITH ev AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, ANY_VALUE(payer_class) payer_class, COUNT(*) n_events,
                   BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) cur_ok,
                   BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication) has_cur
            FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS pairs_remitted,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_events=1 AND cur_ok) AS first_pass_resolved,
       ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_events=1 AND cur_ok)/COUNT(*),2) AS rate_pct
FROM ev GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH pr AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, ANY_VALUE(payer_class) payer_class,
                   COUNT(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) n_trace, BOOL_OR(is_reversal) has_rev,
                   BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication) has_cur,
                   COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication),0) cur_paid
            FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2),
m AS (SELECT * FROM pr WHERE n_trace>=2)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS pairs, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_rev) AS with_reversal,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_cur) AS no_current, ROUND(SUM(cur_paid),2) AS current_paid
FROM m GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (SELECT remit_claim_id FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied),
l AS (SELECT l.* FROM sem.remit_lines l JOIN cur USING (remit_claim_id) WHERE l.line_is_denied)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS denied_lines FROM l

WITH prim AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims
               WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2),
adj AS (SELECT a.adjustment_amount FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN prim p USING (claim_key, payer_key)
        WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code='PR' AND a.carc_code='1')
SELECT SUM(adjustment_amount) AS primary_deductible FROM adj

WITH lat AS (SELECT claim_key, service_month, referring_npi FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission
             AND service_date_from >= DATE '2026-06-01'),
cnt AS (SELECT service_month, referring_npi, COUNT(*) n FROM lat GROUP BY 1,2),
rk AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service_month ORDER BY n DESC, referring_npi) r FROM cnt),
m AS (SELECT service_month, SUM(n) total, SUM(n) FILTER (WHERE r<=5) top5 FROM rk GROUP BY 1)
SELECT strftime(service_month,'%Y-%m') AS month, total AS total_claims, top5 AS top5_claims,
       ROUND(100.0*top5/total,1) AS top5_share_pct FROM m ORDER BY service_month

WITH cur AS (SELECT procedure_code, line_paid_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication),
tot AS (SELECT SUM(line_paid_amount) t, SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='87798') x FROM cur)
SELECT ROUND(x/t,4) AS share_fraction, x AS cpt_paid, t AS total_paid FROM tot

WITH cur AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication),
cpts AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, procedure_code FROM sem.claim_lines),
j AS (SELECT c.procedure_code, cur.claim_key, cur.payer_key, cur.is_denied FROM cur JOIN cpts c USING (claim_key)),
g AS (SELECT procedure_code, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) d FROM j GROUP BY 1)
SELECT procedure_code, n AS adjudications, d AS denied, ROUND(100.0*d/n,2) AS denial_rate_pct
FROM g WHERE n>=20 ORDER BY denial_rate_pct DESC, procedure_code

WITH prim AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims
               WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2),
lat AS (SELECT claim_key, line_count, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission),
cur AS (SELECT r.claim_key, r.is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN prim p USING (claim_key, payer_key)
        WHERE r.is_current_adjudication),
j AS (SELECT CASE WHEN l.line_count>=3 THEN '3+' ELSE CAST(l.line_count AS VARCHAR) END bucket, c.is_denied, l.charge_amount
      FROM cur c JOIN lat l USING (claim_key))
SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) claims, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) denied_claims,
       ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied)/COUNT(*),2) denial_rate_pct,
       COALESCE(SUM(charge_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_denied),0) denied_billed
FROM j GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH cf AS (SELECT payer_key, reference_id, payment_date, provider_adjustment_amount amt FROM sem.provider_adjustments
            WHERE plb_reason_code='FB' AND provider_adjustment_amount<0),
off AS (SELECT cf.reference_id, cf.payment_date cf_date, -cf.amt AS amount,
               (SELECT MIN(o.payment_date) FROM sem.provider_adjustments o WHERE o.plb_reason_code='FB'
                 AND o.payer_key=cf.payer_key AND o.reference_id=cf.reference_id
                 AND o.provider_adjustment_amount=-cf.amt AND o.payment_date>cf.payment_date) off_date FROM cf)
SELECT reference_id, cf_date AS carried_forward_date, ROUND(amount,2) amount, off_date AS offset_date,
       off_date - cf_date AS days_between FROM off ORDER BY cf_date, reference_id

WITH cur AS (SELECT payer_class, strftime(payment_date,'%Y-%m') m, paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication),
s AS (SELECT payer_class, SUM(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE m='2026-07') jul, SUM(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE m='2026-08') aug FROM cur GROUP BY 1),
t AS (SELECT SUM(jul) tj, SUM(aug) ta FROM s),
sh AS (SELECT payer_class, 100.0*COALESCE(jul,0)/tj js, 100.0*COALESCE(aug,0)/NULLIF(ta,0) asx FROM s, t)
SELECT payer_class, ROUND(js,1) jul_share, ROUND(asx,1) aug_share, ROUND(asx-js,1) change_pp FROM sh ORDER BY payer_class

WITH orig AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) o FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' AND frequency_code='1' GROUP BY 1,2),
rep AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) r FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' AND frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2),
j AS (SELECT * FROM rep JOIN orig USING (claim_key, payer_key)),
pay AS (SELECT j.*, rc.payment_date, rc.paid_amount FROM j LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims rc
        ON rc.claim_key=j.claim_key AND rc.payer_key=j.payer_key AND rc.is_current_adjudication AND rc.payment_date>=j.r)
SELECT COUNT(*) corrected_claims, ROUND(AVG(r-o),2) avg_days_to_replacement,
       COUNT(payment_date) paid_after, ROUND(AVG(payment_date-o),2) avg_days_to_payment,
       SUM(paid_amount) total_paid FROM pay

WITH v AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) vd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='8' GROUP BY 1,2),
x AS (SELECT v.claim_key,
        EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=v.claim_key AND r.paid_amount>0 AND r.payment_date<v.vd) paid_before,
        EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=v.claim_key AND r.is_reversal AND r.payment_date>=v.vd) reversed,
        (SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=v.claim_key AND r.is_current_adjudication) cur_paid
      FROM v)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT claim_key) voided_claims, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_before) paid_before_void,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reversed) reversed_after, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cur_paid),0),2) current_paid FROM x

WITH cur AS (SELECT * FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_paid_not_denied FROM cur WHERE paid_amount=0 AND NOT is_denied

WITH rep AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) r FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2),
resp AS (SELECT rep.claim_key, rc.payer_class, MIN(rc.payment_date) - rep.r AS days FROM rep JOIN sem.remit_claims rc
         ON rc.claim_key=rep.claim_key AND rc.payer_key=rep.payer_key AND rc.payment_date>=rep.r GROUP BY rep.claim_key, rep.payer_key, rc.payer_class, rep.r)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) corrected_claims, ROUND(AVG(days),1) avg_days, MIN(days) min_days, MAX(days) max_days
FROM resp GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH pr AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, BOOL_OR(is_reversal) rev, BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication) cur FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS reversed_no_current FROM pr WHERE rev AND NOT cur

WITH cur AS (SELECT procedure_code, line_paid_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication),
tot AS (SELECT SUM(line_paid_amount) t, SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='80307') x FROM cur)
SELECT ROUND(x/t,4) AS share_fraction, x AS cpt_paid, t AS total_paid FROM tot

WITH prim AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims
               WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2),
coh AS (SELECT p.*, (SELECT ANY_VALUE(payer_class) FROM sem.claims c WHERE c.claim_key=p.claim_key AND c.payer_key=p.payer_key) payer_class
        FROM prim p WHERE first_sub BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'),
fr AS (SELECT coh.*, (SELECT MIN(payment_date) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=coh.claim_key AND r.payer_key=coh.payer_key) first_remit FROM coh)
SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) cohort_claims, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_remit-first_sub<=14) remitted_14d,
       ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_remit-first_sub<=14)/COUNT(*),1) share_pct
FROM fr GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (SELECT procedure_code, line_paid_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication),
tot AS (SELECT SUM(line_paid_amount) t, SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='G0482') x FROM cur)
SELECT ROUND(x/t,4) AS share_fraction, x AS cpt_paid, t AS total_paid FROM tot

WITH rep AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) r FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2),
dn AS (SELECT rep.* FROM rep WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims x WHERE x.claim_key=rep.claim_key AND x.payer_key=rep.payer_key
        AND x.claim_status_code='4' AND x.payment_date<rep.r)),
o AS (SELECT dn.*,
        EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims x WHERE x.claim_key=dn.claim_key AND x.payer_key=dn.payer_key AND x.payment_date>=dn.r) after_,
        (SELECT ANY_VALUE(is_denied) FROM sem.remit_claims x WHERE x.claim_key=dn.claim_key AND x.payer_key=dn.payer_key AND x.is_current_adjudication) cur_den,
        (SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM sem.remit_claims x WHERE x.claim_key=dn.claim_key AND x.payer_key=dn.payer_key AND x.is_current_adjudication) cur_paid FROM dn),
c AS (SELECT CASE WHEN NOT after_ THEN 'no remit since correction' WHEN cur_den IS FALSE THEN 'overturned' ELSE 'denied again' END outcome, cur_paid FROM o)
SELECT outcome, COUNT(*) claims, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cur_paid),0),2) total_paid FROM c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied),
prev AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE NOT is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_reversal AND is_denied)
SELECT COUNT(*) overturned_pairs, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount),0) total_current_paid FROM cur JOIN prev USING (claim_key, payer_key)

WITH prim AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims
               WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2),
lat AS (SELECT claim_key, frequency_code, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission),
open_ AS (SELECT p.*, l.charge_amount FROM prim p JOIN lat l USING (claim_key) WHERE l.frequency_code<>'8'
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=p.claim_key AND r.payer_key=p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication)),
b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN DATE '2026-08-14'-first_sub<=14 THEN '0-14' WHEN DATE '2026-08-14'-first_sub<=29 THEN '15-29' ELSE '30+' END bucket, charge_amount FROM open_)
SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) claims, SUM(charge_amount) billed FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH firsts AS (SELECT claim_key, MIN(submission_date) f FROM sem.claims GROUP BY 1),
jul AS (SELECT claim_key FROM firsts WHERE f>=DATE '2026-07-01' AND f<DATE '2026-08-01')
SELECT COUNT(*) never_remitted FROM jul WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=jul.claim_key)

WITH l AS (SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount a FROM sem.remit_lines
           WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied AND units_paid=1 AND line_allowed_amount>0),
f AS (SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, a, COUNT(*) n FROM l GROUP BY 1,2,3),
typ AS (SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, a typical FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY payer_name, procedure_code ORDER BY n DESC, a DESC) r FROM f) WHERE r=1),
u AS (SELECT l.payer_name, typical-a short FROM l JOIN typ USING (payer_name, procedure_code) WHERE a<typical),
p AS (SELECT DISTINCT payer_name FROM l)
SELECT p.payer_name, COUNT(u.short) underpaid_lines, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(u.short),0),2) shortfall
FROM p LEFT JOIN u USING (payer_name) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY shortfall DESC, payer_name

WITH cur AS (SELECT procedure_code, line_paid_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication),

WITH prim AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims
               WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2),
ref AS (SELECT claim_key, referring_npi FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission),
cur AS (SELECT r.claim_key, r.is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN prim USING (claim_key, payer_key) WHERE r.is_current_adjudication),
g AS (SELECT referring_npi, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) d FROM cur JOIN ref USING (claim_key) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT referring_npi, n claims, d denied, ROUND(100.0*d/n,2) denial_rate_pct FROM g WHERE n>=15 ORDER BY d*1.0/n DESC, referring_npi LIMIT 5
